sources.note: Homepage — tagline 'Custom EHR Solutions for Modern Healthcare' / 'EHR Your Way'. JS-heavy site, limited content from raw fetch but search engine snippets confirm correctional/behavioral health/juvenile focus.

Main Spark product page. Describes certified EHR for correctional healthcare, behavioral health, juvenile programs. Details on workflow management, compliance, flexible configuration, real-time reporting, data security, permission-based access. Lists 15 interface categories (tracking, pharmacy, labs, radiology, charges, sick call, immunization registries, HIE, custody, hospitals, US Marshals, SureScripts, Carequality, portals, AI tools). Integrated billing section with eligibility checks, automatic code assignment, claim submission (Medicare/Medicaid/private), ERA posting. Hosting options: cloud (Kalleo Technologies), hybrid, self-hosted.

Correctional solutions page. Unified patient chart (medical, dental, behavioral health). eMAR medication management. OMS/JMS, pharmacy, lab interfaces. Compliance with NCCHC, ACA, AJA accreditation. Risk management through detailed documentation.

Juvenile solutions page. Features: release planning, medication compliance, unified health record, data-driven insights, personalized protocols, patient portal for guardian access/consent, immunization registry, automated wellness checks. Interfaces with labs, resident tracking, pharmacy.

Detailed interface descriptions: Tracking software (demographics, photos, locations, admission/discharge), Pharmacy (bidirectional orders/substitutions/barcoding), Lab (orders and results), Radiology (orders and interpretations), Charges feed (commissary billing), Sick call (kiosk/phone/tablet requests), Immunization/cancer registries, HIE, Hospitals (lab results/transcriptions), US Marshals documentation, SureScripts (12-month Rx history), Carequality, Patient portal, AI/analytical tools.

Solutions overview page. Four market segments: Correctional, Juvenile, One-Off (custom), Healthcare Vendors. Mentions CBI Dashboard with Microsoft Power BI. Reporting engine for compliance, productivity, and data monitoring.

ONC mandatory disclosures page. Spark 7.1 certified 01.14.2020. Describes as 'leading nationwide provider of customizable EHR solutions.' Software license + implementation + annual maintenance fees. NewCrop ePrescribing required for Meaningful Use. EMR Direct Interoperability Engine for API access. Records exportable in PDF or C-CDA format. Supports multiple CMS clinical quality measures.
About page — JS-rendered, could not extract content via fetch. Browser snapshot not attempted.

ZoomInfo company profile. Founded 2006, based in Paducah KY. Nationwide provider of customizable EHR for correctional, juvenile, and multi-disciplinary healthcare. 20+ years experience, 99% customer satisfaction. President: Dan Jarrett. Competitors: AltaPoint Data Systems, FoxFire Systems Group, ChartLogic, The Joxel Group.

CB Insights profile confirming CorrecTek as correctional-specific EHR provider managing medication administration, documentation, medical orders, and reporting for correctional facilities including county jails, prisons, and juvenile detention centers.
